modern-deer-set-2-pcs-christmas.t: Modern Two-Piece Reindeer Set for Festive Shelves
modern-deer-set-2-pcs-christmas.d: A clean, low-poly pair of reindeer brings a calm Scandinavian feel to any mantel or shelf. Print them in matte white, walnut brown, or a glossy metallic to match your holiday palette.

cute-christmas-elf-3d-print.t: Cheeky Christmas Elf With an Oversized Hat
cute-christmas-elf-3d-print.d: This pint-sized elf has a beaming grin and a hat that flops just right for a playful shelf accent. It is a quick single-color print that looks great beside a stack of wrapped gifts.

christmas-city-lights-reindeer-stand.d: A layered reindeer silhouette catches warm LED glow like a tiny winter skyline on your desk. Drop in a tea light or small bulb and the cutouts throw soft festive patterns across the wall.

nutcracker-3d-christmas-stl.d: A stately nutcracker soldier ready to line your entryway or sideboard this season. The detailed uniform reads beautifully in a single bold color with a few hand-painted highlights.

winter-wonderland-3d-light-stand-stl-3mf.d: Stacked snowy scenes nest inside this light stand for a diorama that glows from within. It is a lovely centerpiece for a console table through the whole winter.

merry-christmas-3d-print.d: Chunky three-dimensional letters spell out the season's greeting for a shelf or photo backdrop. Hang them, lean them, or scatter them with pine sprigs for an easy festive vignette.

angel-wings-candle-holder.d: Delicate feathered wings cradle a single taper for a serene, heavenly glow. It makes a quiet statement on a dinner table or bedside through the holidays.

cute-christmas-angel-figure-set.t: Set of Smiling Christmas Angel Figures
cute-christmas-angel-figure-set.d: A small chorus of round-cheeked angels adds sweetness to any nativity or shelf display. They print fast and look charming painted in soft pastels.

angel-christmas-tree-decoration-ornament.d: A gentle angel topper-style ornament that hangs or crowns your tree with calm. The smooth geometry catches light nicely in resin or matte PLA.

angel-candle-holder.d: A serene angel form holds a tea light for a warm, meditative flicker. Place a few along a windowsill to greet the long winter evenings.

reindeer-figurines-set.d: A little herd of reindeer that arranges into a sweet winter tableau on any surface. Mix poses and colors to build your own tiny woodland scene.

christmas-reindeer-forrest-light-stand.t: Reindeer in the Forest Light Stand
christmas-reindeer-forrest-light-stand.d: Layered pines and a watchful reindeer come alive when lit from behind. The forest cutouts cast gentle shadows that shift as the candle burns low.

cute-snowman-3d-print.d: A round, friendly snowman that brings winter cheer without the cold. Set him on a bookshelf or windowsill where the soft curves read from across the room.

cute-christmas-reindeer-3d.t: Cute Cartoon Reindeer With a Bright Red Nose
cute-christmas-reindeer-3d.d: A chunky, happy reindeer with a glowing nose that steals the show on any shelf. Print the nose in translucent red for a subtle holiday wink.

christmas-tree-3d-stl.d: A crisp, faceted tree that nods to modern minimalist holiday styling. It prints clean in one go and suits a desk, entryway, or gift topper.

3-pcs-christmas-cookie-cutter.d: Shape dough into trees, stars, and stockings for a baking afternoon with the kids. Food-safe prints make holiday cookie trays feel handmade and personal.

santa-house-christmas-stl-3d-print.d: A cozy cottage with a snow-dusted roof that feels straight out of a storybook. Light it from within or leave it matte for a calm, collectible vignette.
